courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Beginning Yoruba
courses.description: An intensive beginning course with an emphasis on basic skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 601C and 506 may not both be counted. Yoruba 601C and 507 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: First-Year Yoruba I
courses.description: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba. Standard Yoruba of southwest Nigeria. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 601C and 506 may not both be counted.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: First-Year Yoruba II
courses.description: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba. Continuation of the study of standard Yoruba of southwest Nigeria. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 601C and 507 may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Yoruba 506 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Yoruba 506 with a grade of at least C.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Intermediate Yoruba
courses.description: An intensive intermediate course with emphasis on basic skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 611C and 312K may not both be counted. Yoruba 611C and 312L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Yoruba 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Yoruba 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Second-Year Yoruba I
courses.description: Oral expression, reading, and comprehension. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 611C and 312K may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Yoruba 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Yoruba 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Second-Year Yoruba II
courses.description: Continuation of the study of oral expression, reading, and comprehension. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 611C and 312L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Yoruba 312K with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Yoruba 312K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Topics in Yoruba
courses.description: This course is used to record credit the student earns while enrolled at another institution in a program administered by the University's Study Abroad Office. Credit is recorded as assigned by the study abroad adviser in the Department of African and African Diaspora Studies. University credit is awarded for work in an exchange program; it may be counted as coursework taken in residence. Transfer credit is awarded for work in an affiliated studies program. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary.
